noGmBehavior.name: When no GM is online
noGmBehavior.hint: Rolls are only recorded while a GM is connected. Choose what happens to rolls made when no GM is online.

developerMode.name: Developer mode
developerMode.hint: Shows tools for testing the Roll Tracker, such as generating fake rolls. Not needed for normal games.

showDataJournal.name: Show data journal
showDataJournal.hint: Show the hidden "Roll Tracker Data" journal in the Journal sidebar, for troubleshooting. Don't edit it by hand.

menu.name: Manage roll data
menu.label: Manage roll data
menu.hint: Reset recorded rolls, pause tracking, and (in developer mode) generate fake rolls for testing.

reset.intro: Delete recorded rolls for the heroes you pick. A roll shared with other heroes (Acting Together) stays for them.
reset.noneSelected: Pick at least one hero to reset.
reset.title: Reset roll data
reset.confirm: Delete {count} rolls? This can't be undone.
reset.confirmShared: {count} shared rolls will stay for the other heroes in them.

tracking.pausedHint: No rolls are recorded until you resume. Everyone sees a "Tracking paused" note in the Roll Tracker.

fake.intro: Add sample rolls to test the Roll Tracker. Fake rolls use each hero's real tags and can be removed without touching real rolls.
fake.noHeroes: Pick at least one hero first.
fake.wipeConfirm: Remove all {count} fake rolls? Real rolls are kept. This can't be undone.
